category: multi-hoster (premium link generator and torrent seedbox)

free_tier.stated: As a free user, you can debride one link at a time. The FAQ puts the free account at 'up to 1 link per day'. The guest downloader covers only hosts that are already free: 1fichier, facebook, redtube, twitter, xnxx, xvideos, youporn, youtube.
free_tier.notes: Two different numbers appear. The FAQ says 1 link/day for a free account. The API reference says 70 unique files per 24 h per account (error 121), which is the paid-account ceiling. The conservative figure is used here. Guest 1fichier allowance is its own counter: 'Links : 0/1 Per Day'.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the service unlocks a file-host URL and does not store the object
per_object_cap.notes: The paid plan advertises 'Unlimited remote traffic', which is a transfer claim, not a per-object size.

retention.stated: not applicable: no storage product. Generated links are temporary and the downloader keeps a history of them for the account.

egress.terms: Download runs from BestDebrid's servers for a user. Premium advertises 'Unlimited bandwidth' and 'Unlimited remote traffic(1)', with the footnote 'Remote traffic (excluding Internet service providers)'. Free users are capped by links per day, not by bytes.
egress.free_allowance: 1 link/day (free account); per-host counters shown live, e.g. 1fichier 0/1 per day

interface_detail: REST API documented at /fr/restapi.php with API keys, per-host limits endpoint and error codes; the support form lists 'JDownloader, Kodi, Stremio, WebDAV, API' as client categories.
tooling: JDownloader/IDM via the API, a documented REST API, and a browser downloader. No rclone backend.
chaining: A sub-USD-5 one-time 15-day pass (EUR 3) at unlimited remote traffic is the cheapest per-TB route for a client who needs many file hosts rather than torrent cache; it pairs with JDownloader for a resumable queue.

limits.value: 1 link per day on a free account; 70 unique files per 24 h on a paid account (web and API combined)
1 concurrent link as a free user; error 122 'Too many unrestricts in progress - retry in ~1 min'
error 632 'VPN/proxy detected' and error 56 'Invalid IP address, waiting time not elapsed' block datacentre and VPN egress

limits_note: Hosts go offline individually; the downloader page showed 51 of 52 hosts online and filejoker listed as offline on the read date.
binding_note: On the paid tier the same counter binds first at 70 files per 24 h.

identity_cost.detail: Free account needs a username, an email address and a password. Google and Facebook sign-in also offered. No card and no phone on the free path. Paid plans are bought as a key or by subscription.

reliability_note: Free tier covers only hosts that are already free; filejoker was offline on the read date; VPN and proxy egress is refused with error 632; the paid plan allows VPN.
confidence_note: Free and paid limits are quoted from the vendor's FAQ, plans page and API reference. A generated link pulled end to end would raise it to measured.

evidence.proved: 'As a free user, you can debride one link at a time', the free-host list (1fichier facebook redtube twitter xnxx xvideos youporn youtube), 'Files per day: 0/100', 'Bandwidth per day: 2147483647 GB', and the 1fichier counter 'Links : 0/1 Per Day'
The free account 'includes several limitations: fewer supported file hosts; up to 1 link per day; limited access to certain features'
One-time prices EUR 3 / 15 days, EUR 5 / 31 days, EUR 25 / 180 days, EUR 45 / 365 days, and a EUR 4.50/month auto-renewing subscription, each with 'Unlimited remote traffic' and seedbox

'Quota journalier : chaque compte est limité à 70 fichiers uniques par 24 h, web et API confondus (erreur 121)', error 56 (free daily quota), error 122 (concurrency), error 632 (VPN/proxy), and a per-host limits endpoint returning 'linksperday' and 'bandwidth' such as '150 GB'

price_per_tb_month: EUR 4.50/month subscription; EUR 3 per 15 days one-time (USD 5.05 and USD 3.37 at the 2026-10-23 ECB-derived rate of 0.8915 EUR per USD)
notes: The free tier is not a free multi-hoster: its host list is the set of hosts that need no debrid. The sub-USD-5 band is the paid side. USD conversions use the exchangerate-api USD base read on 2026-10-23 (EUR 0.891529 per USD). Cheapest per-month shape is the 365-day one-time pass at EUR 45, or EUR 3 per 15 days for a short burst. The '2147483647 GB' bandwith figure is 2^31-1, an integer sentinel, not a measured allowance.

extras.free_hosts: 1fichier, facebook, redtube, twitter, xnxx, xvideos, youporn, youtube
